lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form II) passive perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَحُصِّلَ is in the derivative form: حُصِّلَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ح/ص/ل   ḥ–ṣ–l residue, yield, crop; result, to come out, reject, waste; to collect. Of this root, حُصِّلَ ḥuṣṣila occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
حُصِّلَ ḥuṣṣila [pass. of v. II] to be collected, to be made manifest

(100:10) وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى الصُّدُورِ when what is in the bosoms (or, the minds) is brought out (or, gathered/scrutinized).
